answer.rationale: Primary region p99 latency is 5x target and climbing; this is exactly the scenario memory_b2 documents succeeding at (fast latency recovery, clean traffic shift, minutes to error rate restoration). Rollback is blocked by the compliance-required security patch. Capacity addition and read replica routing address long-term load but won't resolve acute write-path degradation during settlement peak. Regional failover isolates the degraded primary and shifts traffic to a known-good region, preserving write durability while we investigate root cause. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) are appropriate as a secondary containment layer if failover surfaces dependency issues, but won't resolve primary region saturation. Verify memory_b2 to confirm the failover playbook worked under similar peak load conditions before committing.
